// diagnostic

E0933

An impl lacks a constant its trait declares

What

An impl lacks a constant its trait declares

Why

A trait constant without a default is given by each implementation, so a read of it on the type finds a value

Fix

Add `name :: value` to the impl

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0933: tests/ui/trait_constant_missing_e0933.stderr.

Error [jet.MissingTraitConstant]: `Square` implements `Shape` without its constant `sides`
  --> tests/ui/trait_constant_missing_e0933.jet:10:6
    |
 10 | impl Square.Shape {
    |      ^^^^^^
 Why: `Shape` declares `sides: Int` with no default, so each implementation gives its value
 Fix: Add `sides :: value` to the impl
